notable_absence.finding: No Enterprise/Community edition badge appears anywhere on this page (the other known recurring anomaly from prior rounds). Feature/tier distinctions here are expressed exclusively through commercial Support Plan names (Basic/Developer Pro/Enterprise), never through a product-edition axis, consistent with Capella having no discrete EE/CE split.

cross_component_finding: The Alert Recipients table exposes two Capella management-plane roles (Project Creator, Organization Member) that are not among the three roles already promoted to the capella-role catalog (organization-owner/project-owner/project-data-writer) - the real management-plane role catalog is larger than that trio suggested, at least 5 roles wide so far.
